summary: Frontend-only verification of the five preset-scaffold dashboards (Asset Intelligence, AI Governance, Third-Party Risk, Decisions, Risk Register) as an admin (jblan2026@gmail.com) on the live_only sparse-data org. All five pages render fully with their page-level data-testid, exactly 6 KPI tiles each, the AI Insight card, all requested sub-cards (heatmap 25 cells, OWASP LLM01–LLM10 = 10 rows, aig-usage-trend, aig-by-model, ai-monitoring, vnd-renewals, rr-loss/trending/deficiencies/initiatives/top-assets, asset-devices/inventory, etc). None of the pages white-screen; empty states inside cards where the underlying dataset is sparse (0 vendors, 0 agents, 0 recs) are graceful and expected. Distinct accents visible per dashboard (amber / rose / teal / violet / indigo). AI Insight Analyze button on Asset Intelligence returned 200 from POST /api/advisor/insight (anthropic/claude-opus-4-8) and rendered a headline + 4 insight bullets + recommended actions in ~1s. Asset row click opened asset-detail-pane with IP/host/TLS/server metadata correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking [data-testid=risk-row-LR-001] the sidebar aside [data-testid=risk-detail-pane] did not appear in DOM (locator count=0) at 1920px viewport, despite `hidden md:block` visibility class and `selected` state toggling. The detail data does render elsewhere on the page but the specifically-testid'ed pane was not present. Suspected: previously-selected row may have toggled off on second click, or aside stays offscreen. Non-blocking.

issues: Persistent 'Meet your Obserrian Advisor' floating tooltip in bottom-right overlaps 'Connected sources' / table rows / renewals card on multiple pages — consider z-index or dismiss-on-scroll.

action_items: Investigate risk-detail-pane rendering after single row click at desktop viewport (may be a toggle/state issue in RiskRegister.jsx around `selected` state).
Consider auto-dismissing or z-index'ing down the 'Meet your Obserrian Advisor' bottom-right pop-in so it doesn't overlap live cards.

The data-testid slug format for AI Insight buttons is derived from the human dashboard title (e.g. ai-insight-run-Asset-Intelligence, ai-insight-run-Recommendations---Decisions) not from the URL slug — request spec called them `ai-insight-run-<dashboard-slug>`. Confirm this naming is intentional; otherwise normalize to url-slug form (assets/ai-governance/vendors/decisions/risks) for stable automation.
critical_code_review_comments: AIInsight testid derived from display name creates awkward IDs like `ai-insight-run-Recommendations---Decisions` (triple hyphen) and `ai-insight-Third-Party-Risk`; preferable to accept an explicit `slug` prop.

RiskRegister.jsx conditional sidebar (`{selected && <aside>}`) has no fallback empty state — first-load users see no pane at all; consider a persistent aside with 'Select a risk to inspect' placeholder for scaffold-always principle.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (5/5 dashboards render, all KPI/scaffold cards present, AI Insight works; 1 minor risk-detail-pane discovery gap)
